title: pm: after the `.claude/**` declaration split lands, the relay review plan and the patrol landing row still read the raw Tier S and never ask the maintainer
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgVaDMEnj7SrgKsMrWN

Filing gate: ① defect with a named landing point · Source: fleet · follow-up owed by PR #35610 (card #35321), named in os-dev-report 7016679857 (open question 3 and its out-of-scope notes); the seat ruled one card for the group, p2, `area:fleet`. Same family as #31690 and #33540 (closed): a reader of the register that did not chain a split the queue guard already applies. ⛔ Not a claim.

Blocked-by: #35610

Grade: area:fleet · Task · fleet machinery, no product surface · every objectstack pull that touches the root `.claude/**` tree once #35610 merges · read from the code at the head of #35610 (`cd8dab31`), not measured on a live pull → p2.

Reader: the objectstack seat holding `area:fleet`, after #35610 merges. Serial with whoever is editing `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` at that time (area b1-H of seat `repo:objectstack#1` today): overlap-check decides the queue.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：用户无感。车队内部：改车队规则条文的 PR 会自动请你审，不再只是在合并队列被拦下后才有人发现要找你。
- 为什么做：#35610 让「改规则的车队文档要你批」在合并队列生效，但自动请审和每日巡查这两处还按旧办法读，声明了改规则的 PR 不会自动送到你面前。
- 出错会怎样：最多是多请你审一次或漏请一次，合并队列那道拦截不受影响；可整体撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What is there (head of #35610, `cd8dab31`)

#35610 adds `applyRuleChangeSplit` to `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs`: a pull touching the root `.claude/**` tree is Tier S only with the body's line-start `Rule-change: none` (or `ruled` with its ruling reference) and a verified PASS record; anything else is Tier H. The queue guard and `--pr` chain it. Two other readers do not (`applyRuleChangeSplit` has no caller outside `check-governed-merges.mjs` and the queue guard):

1. `governedReviewPlan` in `scripts/pm/fleet-write/execute.mjs` reads `landingTierOf(applyLowRiskArm(applyWorkflowSplit(matched, …)))`. For a `.claude/**`-only pull that is the raw row's Tier S, so the relay requests no approver at `pr_create` or `pr_ready`, even when the body declares `Rule-change: yes`. The pull is refused at the queue, and nobody was asked.
2. The patrol's landing row H43 in `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` reads the same `landingTierOf` on the matched slice, so a `.claude/**` pull that declares a rule change is not listed as waiting for the maintainer.

Both readers already hold the pull object, so the body is in hand.

## Work items

- [ ] `governedReviewPlan` chains `applyRuleChangeSplit` after the low-risk arm, with the body reading; a `.claude/**` pull that declares `yes`, declares nothing, or sits under `.claude/settings*.json` or `.claude/hooks/**` requests the approvers; a declared `none` requests nobody. Self-test cases for each.
- [ ] H43 chains it the same way and lists such a pull as Tier H. Self-test cases for each.
- [ ] The `pull_request` early-warning leg of the queue guard reads the PR body from the event payload, so a `.claude/**` diff that declares `none` is no longer printed as "Tier H until the PR body is read". (From the dev report; not re-measured by this seat.)
- [ ] The post-merge sweep in `check-governed-merges.mjs` re-reads the declaration and the verified line of a merged `.claude/**` pull and lists a landing whose record did not verify. (From the dev report; not re-measured by this seat.)
- [ ] With `hotcrm` on the `workflows` row, both readers now treat a hotcrm workflow pull as Tier H: confirm the relay requests the approver there and pin it.

## Not a work item: one question for the maintainer

The modules the guard imports (`clause2-line.mjs`, `check-half-states.mjs`, `check-handover.mjs`, `fleet-write/ops.mjs`, `dispatch-gates.data.mjs`) are not register rows; his order on #35321 names four files. Adding rows widens what needs his approval, so it is his to say and is not built under this card. (From the dev report; the import list is not re-measured by this seat.)

## Done when

- A `.claude/**` pull opened through the relay with `Rule-change: yes` gets the approver requested at `pr_create`, and H43 lists it as Tier H; with `Rule-change: none` neither happens. Each is pinned by a self-test with its negative control.
- `pnpm check:pm-governed-merges`, `pnpm check:pm-half-states` and `pnpm check:pm-fleet-write-execute` are green.

Dedupe: issue search `governedReviewPlan` → 7 hits, all closed (#33540, #31690, #25782, #33501, #25199, #33603, #31538), none on the rule-change split; open issues with "Rule-change" in title or body → 22 hits, all 22 titles read, only #35321 is about the declaration.
